description:
Stylish two bedroom apartment available at Candle House; a striking cylindrical tower at Granary Wharf, a popular Waterside development only moments from the train station. Granary Wharf consists of two residential buildings, a hotel and a number of amenities including shops, bars and restaurants. This well presented high specification 16th floor two bedroom apartment benefits from a well-designed kitchen including fridge/freezer, microwave and dishwasher, with a washer/dryer situated in the utility room off the hallway. There is a South facing balcony off the living area with stunning views of the canal and Leeds city centre. Residents also have exclusive use of the 21st floor communal roof terrace which provides 360 degree views over Leeds. The apartment is in pristine condition and furnished to a high standard, the master bedroom benefits from a walk in dressing room providing ample storage, second double bedroom and stylish house Bathroom with shower over bath. The rent includes water rates. This apartment must be viewed! Furnished. Bond £1,525. Available Now! EPC rating -B, council tax band D.
Communal Hallway  
Stairs and lift to all floors.
Lounge  
Light and airy lounge with views across the City, doors opening to a south facing balcony, open plan to kitchen.
Kitchen 
A range of wall and base units with worktops over, electric oven and hob, sink with mixer tap. integrated appliances including dishwasher.  
Bedroom 1 
Carpeted double bedroom with floor to ceiling windows.
Bedroom 2  
Carpeted double bedroom with floor to ceiling windows.
Bathroom  
Fitted with a three piece bathroom suite with shower over bath, shower screen, w/c and hand wash basin, large mirror.
Holding Fee  
Please note, a holding fee equivalent to one week rent is payable upon application and this will be part of the first month rental.
